95632 - Tornado Fleet Issue With the specter of Conquest technology on the horizon in YC128, the Republic Fleet issued a request for a new Balttlecruiser that might help provide some edge to the strike teams expected to be a part of that conflict. Though Conquest technology had been restricted by agreement with CONCORD, many felt that its deployment was inevitable, and the Minmatar wished to be proactive in their fear.

The result was the Tornado Fleet issue, an advanced Republic Fleet vessel. Despite its proud suite of improvements over the original model, detractors claimed that this vessel was merely a conventional weapon that could in no way match the awesome power of the Conquest Engines.		 Attack Battlecruiser

By accessing your registered identity data, these nanoholographic projections emblazon your favorite vessels with symbols that matter to you. And now, by utilizing the latest in cloud-based AI synchronization, emblems remain stable even during warp.

Visit your nearest IRIS and take part in Paragon's latest initiatives to unlock new emblems today.

Paragon; be more.

WARNING: Emblems are auto-injected on purchases and cannot be transferred or traded between capsuleers. The Paragon corporation accepts no liability for failed transfer attempts.		 Ship Emblems

95809 - Small Federation Navy Synchronizer Developed by the Federation Navy, this rig improves hybrid turret, armor repair, and structure hitpoints. It also integrates the pathways between Federation Navy technology. This unlocks even greater performance the more Federation Navy modules are installed.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.

The CPU drawback of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the <a href=showinfo:96100>Synchronization Rigging</a> skill.		 Rig Synchronizer

95859 - Academy Merlin The Merlin is the most powerful combat frigate of the Caldari. Its role has evolved through the years, and while its defenses have always remained exceptionally strong for a Caldari vessel, its offensive capabilities have evolved from versatile, jack-of-all-trades attack patterns into focused and deadly gunfire tactics. The Merlin's primary aim is to have its turrets punch holes in opponents' hulls.

This is a special AIR Academy version of the Merlin. It is provided free of charge to capsuleers within Exordium to assist with their training. It cannot be flown out of Exordium, traded, or reprocessed.		 Frigate

95860 - Academy Incursus The Incursus may be found both spearheading and bulwarking Gallente military operations. Its speed makes it excellent for skirmishing duties, while its resilience helps it outlast its opponents on the battlefield. Incursus-class ships move together in groups and can quickly and effectively gang up on ships many times their size and overwhelm them. In recent years the Incursus has increasingly found its way into the hands of pirates, who love its aggressive appearance.

This is a special AIR Academy version of the Incursus. It is provided free of charge to capsuleers within Exordium to assist with their training. It cannot be flown out of Exordium, traded, or reprocessed.		 Frigate

95862 - Academy Venture Recognizing the dire need for a ship capable of fast operation in unsafe territories, <a href=showinfo:30//500014>ORE</a> created the Venture. It was conceived as a vessel primed and ready for any capsuleer, no matter how new to the dangers of New Eden they might be, who wishes to engage in the respectable trade of mining.

The Venture has amazing abilities to quickly drill through to the ores and gases it's after, harvesting them at the speed necessary for mining in hostile space, and getting out relatively unscathed.

This is a special AIR Academy version of the Venture. It is provided free of charge to capsuleers within Exordium to assist with their training. It cannot be flown out of Exordium, traded, or reprocessed.		 Frigate

95884 - Academy 5MN Microwarpdrive Massive boost to speed for a very short time. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module. The sheer amount of energy needed to power this system means that it must permanently reserve a fraction of the capacitor output just to maintain the integrity of its warp containment field, and when activated it substantially increases the ship's EM footprint.

Penalty: Max capacitor reduced.

Note: Usually fit on Frigates and Destroyers.

This is a special AIR Academy version of a 5MN Microwarpdrive. It is provided free of charge to capsuleers within Exordium to assist with their training. It can only be used with Academy Ships.		 Propulsion Module

96286 - Raspite Z-Grade This rich variant of Raspite ore is especially prized by Amarr engineers for use in large-scale construction projects. Unfortunately, most known deposits of Raspite Z-Grade are found in the contested space of the Amarr and Minmatar warzone.

Unlike regular Raspite ore, Z-Grade is more stable and can be reprocessed without specialized equipment into <a href=showinfo:36>Mexallon</a> and <a href=showinfo:38>Nocxium</a>.

Reprocessing will also produce <a href=showinfo:97512>Aberrant Raspite</a>. The Amarr Empire will reward anyone who accepts their campaign objective and delivers this Aberrant material to their item trader outside the Amarr Navy Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30002974>Mehatoor</url>.		 Raspite

96311 - Imperial Conquest Engine Once active and uncontested, this engine will secure control of this entire star system on the behalf of the Amarr Empire.

The engine makes use of “Conquest technology”, brute force manipulations of hyperspace backward engineered from Drifter technology. A powerful burst of energy is transferred through hyperspace, bypassing three-dimensional defenses and overpowering the command systems in every military complex, defense grid, war facility, and planetary defense system within the local star's gravity well. This grants its masters, the Amarr Empire, uncontested control over the star system for as long as the engine remains active.

The only known force capable of stopping the engine from firing is another Conquest engine, and it must be the sole operational device of its type within range in order to fire.		 Conquest Engine

96313 - Federation Conquest Engine Once active and uncontested, this engine will secure control of this entire star system on the behalf of the Gallente Federation.

The Federation engine is not a true example of Conquest technology. This engine makes use of Rogue Infestation technology to create a facsimile of the hyperspace energy bursts used in true Conquest tech. The AI infestation is overclocked, accelerating its effects to peak performance before being unleashed in order ot overpower the command systems in every military complex, defense grid, war facility, and planetary defense system within the system. This grants the Federation uncontested control over the star system territory for as long as the engine remains active.

The only known force capable of stopping a Conquest engine from firing is another Conquest engine, and the overclocked infestation achieves this by waging a non-stop barrage of cyber attacks on any Conquest engine within range, preventing them from firing as long as it is in operation, but also preventing itself from firing through this process.

Because of this, it must be the sole operational Conquest engine within range in order to activate.		 Conquest Engine

This grants its masters, the Minmatar Republic, uncontested control over the star system for as long as the engine remains active.

The only known force capable of stopping the engine from firing is another Conquest engine, and it must be the sole operational device of its type within range in order to fire.		 Conquest Engine

96541 - Small Dark Blood Synchronizer Built by Blood Raider engineers from combined Amarr and Minmatar synchronizers, this rig improves Energy Nosferatu, Energy Neutralizer and Energy Turret performance. However, the brute force combination that powers this synchronizer takes a significant toll on its capacitor recharge. It also integrates the pathways between Dark Blood technology. This unlocks even greater performance the more Dark Blood modules are installed.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.

The CPU drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the <a href=showinfo:96100>Synchronization Rigging</a> skill.		 Rig Synchronizer

96625 - Small Shadow Serpentis Synchronizer Serpentis developed this synchronizer from stolen Gallente and Minmatar technology. It improves hybrid turret performance, ship maximum velocity, and web resistance. However, Serpentis R&D was unable to recreate the clean signal of the originals, and this rig significantly reduces targeting range. It also integrates the pathways between Shadow Serpentis technology. This unlocks even greater performance the more Shadow Serpentis modules are installed.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.

The CPU drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the <a href=showinfo:96100>Synchronization Rigging</a> skill.		 Rig Synchronizer

96720 - Large Dread Guristas Synchronizer Built from Caldari synchronizers hacked to accommodate Gallente software, this rig improves drones, ECM modules, and shield resistances. However, the incompatibility of the Gallente firmware with Caldari technology results in greatly reduced drone control ranges. It also integrates the pathways between Dread Guristas technology. This unlocks even greater performance the more Dread Guristas modules are installed.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.

The CPU drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the <a href=showinfo:96100>Synchronization Rigging</a> skill.		 Rig Synchronizer

97266 - Academy Kestrel The Kestrel is a heavy missile boat with one of the most sophisticated sensor arrays around. Interestingly enough, it has been used by both the Caldari Navy and several wealthy trade corporations as a cargo-hauling vessel. It is one of few trading vessels with good punching power, making it ideal for solo trade-runs in dangerous areas. The Kestrel was designed so that it could take up to four missile launchers but as a result it can not be equipped with turret weapons nor with mining lasers.

This is a special AIR Academy version of the Kestrel. It is provided free of charge to capsuleers within Exordium to assist with their training. It cannot be flown out of Exordium, traded, or reprocessed.		 Frigate

97267 - Academy Tristan Often nicknamed The Fat Man this nimble little frigate is mainly used by the Federation in escort duties or on short-range patrols. The Tristan has been very popular throughout Gallente space for years because of its versatility. It is rather expensive, but buyers will definitely get their money's worth, as the Tristan is one of the more powerful frigates available on the market.

This is a special AIR Academy version of the Tristan. It is provided free of charge to capsuleers within Exordium to assist with their training. It cannot be flown out of Exordium, traded, or reprocessed.		 Frigate

97268 - Academy Rifter The Rifter is a very powerful combat frigate and can easily tackle the best frigates out there. It has gone through many radical design phases since its inauguration during the Minmatar Rebellion. The Rifter has a wide variety of offensive capabilities, making it an unpredictable and deadly adversary.

This is a special AIR Academy version of the Rifter. It is provided free of charge to capsuleers within Exordium to assist with their training. It cannot be flown out of Exordium, traded, or reprocessed.		 Frigate

97270 - Academy Punisher The Punisher is considered by many to be one of the best Amarr frigates in existence. As evidenced by its heavy armaments, the Punisher is mainly intended for large-scale military operations, acting in coordination with larger military vessels. With its damage output, however, it is also perfectly capable of punching its way right through unwary opponents.

This is a special AIR Academy version of the Punisher. It is provided free of charge to capsuleers within Exordium to assist with their training. It cannot be flown out of Exordium, traded, or reprocessed.		 Frigate

97271 - Academy Tormentor The Tormentor has been in service for many decades. For most of that time it saw service as a mining ship, its size barring it from making any kind of impact on the battlefield. As with most Amarr ships, however, its strong defenses always made it a tough opponent to crack, and with recent advances in turret capacitor use and damage output, its lasers have now stopped digging into dead ore and are instead focused on boring through the hulls of hapless vessels in combat.

This is a special AIR Academy version of the Tormentor. It is provided free of charge to capsuleers within Exordium to assist with their training. It cannot be flown out of Exordium, traded, or reprocessed.		 Frigate

97274 - Academy Magnate This Magnate-class frigate is one of the most decoratively designed ship classes in the Amarr Empire, considered to be a pet project for a small, elite group of royal ship engineers for over a decade. The frigate's design has gone through several stages over the past decade, and new models of the Magnate appear every few years. The most recent versions of this ship – the Silver Magnate and the Gold Magnate – debuted as rewards in the Amarr Championships in YC105, though the original Magnate design is still a popular choice among Amarr pilots.

This is a special AIR Academy version of the Magnate. It is provided free of charge to capsuleers within Exordium to assist with their training. It cannot be flown out of Exordium, traded, or reprocessed.		 Frigate

97544 - Thermoelectric Flux Log The Empire will reward anyone who accepts their campaign objective and delivers this to their item trader outside the Amarr Navy Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30002974>Mehatoor</url>.

Inside this log are Sleeper records about the transfer of thermoelectric energy across the Drifter Hyperspace Network. With enough data of that type, it should be possible to identify their connection to the Emergent Artifact, as well as help the Empire unlock the secrets of superior energy transfer. 97545 - Shield Failover Report The State will reward anyone who accepts their campaign objective and delivers this to their item trader outside the Caldari Navy Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30045324>Onnamon</url>.

Failover data from the loss of Sleeper shields or the overshields of their Drifter masters could help isolate the time component of the Emergent Artifact's manifestation. It also may expose key information about how shielding technology could come back online quickly after a Conquest attack.		 Special Edition Commodities

97547 - Stereo-Collapse Signal The Republic will reward anyone who accepts their campaign objective and delivers this to their item trader outside the Republic Fleet Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30002055>Amo</url>.

This Sleeper data is a hyperspace communication from their Drifter masters that has collapsed into lower-dimensional spacetime upon being received. Not only could these messages contain information that is key to locating the Emergent Artifact, but they could also help unlock the secrets of how to connect hyperspace communications to conventional technology. 97559 - Raspite X-Grade This variant of Raspite ore is especially prized by Amarr engineers for use in large-scale construction projects. Deposits have been held in reserve until such a time as the Empire needed them.

Unlike regular Raspite ore, X-Grade is more stable and can be reprocessed without specialized equipment into <a href=showinfo:34>Tritanium</a> and <a href=showinfo:35>Pyerite</a>.

Reprocessing will also produce <a href=showinfo:97512>Aberrant Raspite</a>. The Amarr Empire will reward anyone who accepts their campaign objective and delivers this Aberrant material to their item trader outside the Amarr Navy Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30002974>Mehatoor</url>.		 Raspite

97747 - Basic Conquest Glamourex Booster Impetus developed the Glamourex neural booster as a means to improve the charm and appeal of its holoreel stars. Generally used at a low dosage on valuable hot properties such as actors and other celebrities, Impetus does make Glamourex available at higher, possibly inadvisable potencies for those who require a rapid boost in their social standing. Working much like the Social skill this booster provides a 20% bonus to agent, corporation and faction standing increases.

Volatile compounds were used to create this booster, limiting its shelf life. It will cease to function after February 2nd, 2027		 Booster

61118 The Intaki Bank has seen brisk business in the decade since it decided to keep the names on all accounts secret and inaccessible to anyone. Everyone knows that dirty money pours in and out of the bank, but the general consensus of the Syndicate is that if it doesn't provide this service, then someone else will. Formerly the Intaki Bank, it was renamed to embrace its identy as part of the unique region, moving away from its Federation-Intaki roots after being brought into the Caldari State in YC128. This change was the result of the State Corridor campaign and the 17,079 capsuleers who contributed to its success.

The bank has thrived even more under State oversight, partly as it was given special dispensation by the Caldari Business Tribunal to maintain its policy of client anonymity. This privacy is very useful to less-than-legitimate business dealers, but it also helps the State and its megacorporations handle some of their own more clandestine affairs. Description of Corporation "Syndicate Bank" (1000144)
61119 The Syndicate is the biggest black market dealer in the world of EVE, a place where shady traders from the outer regions can meet merchants from empire space. Intaki Commerce handles these transactions, making a nice profit for the Syndicate. In YC128, the Caldari State claimed sovereignty over the Syndicate region. In the months that followed, 17,079 capsuleers contributed to the success of their State Corridor campaign that sought to bring some semblance of honorable dealings and lawfulness to the region.

Despite their best efforts, black market deals and illegal trafficking remain common. There are even those who have claimed the Caldari benefit from access to such illicit trading and do not want to shut it down. 61120 The Syndicate wants their space to be relatively trouble-free, so as to encourage people to visit and spend their money. With empire policing infrequent, they employ their own police force to enforce the peace. Under the rule of the Intaki Syndicate, the Space Police struggled to provide limited security to the citizens of their region. In YC128, after the Caldari State claimed sovereignty over Syndicate, 17,079 capsuleers contributed to the success of the State Corridor campaign. A part of that campaign was fostering a relationship of patronage between the Caldari Navy and local police forces. The two organizations now work together to bring some semblance of law to this frontier region. 61121 Formed by Intaki exiles from the Gallente Federation during the Caldari-Gallente War, the Syndicate has slowly grown in stature and influence. It now serves as an important link between the empires and the illegal elements in the outer regions. Syndicate space is a pirate haven but still retains enough civility to allow pretty much anyone to travel there for business. Its markets are always chock full of contraband goods and illegal wares that are hard or impossible to come by elsewhere. Each Syndicate station is an autonomous entity, but they cooperate on security and information issues. The unofficial leader of the Syndicate is Silphy en Diabel, a former Sister of EVE who returned to Syndicate space to save her family's fortune. Since then she's turned out to be just as resourceful and ruthless as her late father. Formerly known as the Intaki Syndicate, it was founded by Intaki who were exiled from the Gallente Federation during the first Caldari-Gallente War. The Syndicate came to serve as a link between the Empires and the criminal underworld.

In YC124, a constellation of Syndicate was granted to the Caldari State in exchange for their protection. That agreement fell apart in YC128 after the Syndicate was blamed for attacks on the gates into Jita. In response, the Caldari annexed the entire Syndicate region.

The State Corridor campaign was initiated with the goal of fostering Caldari control. 17,079 capsuleers contributed to the campaign’s success. Some Syndicate members fled and joined Serpentis or the Guristas, but most came to see the Caldari as their benefactors and protectors, and the Intaki Syndicate was reformed as the State Syndicate.

The Syndicate has been embraced into the bosom of the State, though criminality is far from gone from the region. Beyond the reach of CONCORD, it continues to harbor criminal elements. 141813 After a bit of interrogation, the Ringmaster gave us the information we're looking for. Funny, we barely put any effort into it: She succumbed pretty quickly. Oh well. Since we have her in custody, we'll use her for more questioning later, just as soon as she's rested up and ready for another round.


Anyway, based on her information, we've learned of a nearby Intaki settlement that has some loose association with the Pator 6. You know what the Intaki are like — one big mess of criminals. I don't believe the lies they tell us in the media: All Intaki are a part of the Syndicate, directly or not. If it were up to me, I'd lock all the Intaki up for good, or maybe just send them all back to their cesspool of a home planet.


Go to Pemene and find those Intaki. Keep an eye out for the Pator 6, and report back with any information you receive about the senator's son. You may have to open fire on their settlement in order to get them to talk. If you run into any opposition, use force. You have the authorities on your side. 141884 Truth is the fundamental goal of any good reporter, and we've uncovered enough of it to create a media storm. The power of the press is unprecedented in its ability to sway the general public, create massive sympathy for an unknown issue, and to create a massive backlash against nefarious groups. When we present this evidence on the holovids, there's no hope for the Syndicate. Their reputation will be ruined if anything happens to the kid. This is the power of the media.


We have a satellite station that we like to use for these important broadcasts. It's safely hidden in a secret location in case there's any blowback from our special reports. Take this evidence and drop it off at the station. We'll use that to raise awareness of this case, blow it right open, and turn the wrath of the unwashed masses on the Syndicate. 142120 Though it was difficult, I made my choice: I gave Ralie back to the Syndicate. Why? The money, of course. Those pirates offered way more money than the kid is worth, and I'd be a fool not to take it. I expected them to ambush me when I gave the kid away, but they didn't. Rats can be surprising sometimes. I made sure I didn't look at the kid when I gave him back. I don't want to think about the horrors he's about to face. All I want to think about is all the money I just got. It's enough to keep me happy. Mission Accomplished. Though I wonder: Was it worth it? Though it was difficult, I made my choice: I gave Ralie back to the Syndicate. Why? The money, of course. 142269 You've come a long way, {[character]player.name}. You found the kid, defeated the bad guys, and saved the day. Right out of a holoreel, right? Well, here's where real life comes in, and it's a complicated mess. They don't show you this part in the ‘reels.



While you were out taking care of the Pator 6, I contacted my Syndicate contacts. They're pissed, but they are willing to forget everything and leave us alone. They can still keep their deal with Impetus, but they need the kid. Apparently, Ralie's the crux of the deal. I have no idea why, nor do I want to know.



Thus, you have two options. First, you can do the right thing and give Ralie back to the Feds. Be the hero, save the innocents, gratitude heaped upon you by the Federation, the works. I'm sure Mourmarie has something fun to reward you for your assistance.
<Br>

Or you can give Ralie back to the Syndicate. They've given me a very generous offer. Very generous. You're essentially signing an innocent kid's life away, but the money will be good. That's all you eggers care about anyway, right?



All I can say is this: You can give the kid his freedom and be the hero. Or you can give him away, an innocent kid to ruthless and depraved criminals, for a lot of money. I won't judge you on either choice, but I have to ask: Where do you draw the line?		 You've come a long way, {[character]player.name}. You found the kid, defeated the bad guys, and saved the day. 263226 The Naga was designed in YC 109 by Corporate Police Force as an anti-Guristas ship, sacrificing the usual robust Caldari Navy standards in favor of supporting battleship-class weaponry. It was rejected by Hyasyoda management for being overspecialized.

The Naga design remained in the Hyasyoda archives, forgotten (save for a cameo in the Gallente holo-series CPF Blue). In YC 113 the Caldari Navy entertained contracts for a new tier of gunboat battlecruiser. Hyasyoda quickly submitted and won with the Naga, underbidding both Kaalakiota and Ishukone.		 Faced with the prospect of maintaining order in Syndicate in YC128, a region beyond the reach of CONCORD, the Caldari Navy needed a new hard-hitting solution that would establish State authority through its intimidating presence alone. The Naga Navy Issue was commissioned in partnership with the megacorporations of the Mountain faction to ensure that the newly controlled region would witness the uncompromisable honor and strength of the Caldari. 582523 New Eden's Soldiers of Fortune are capsuleers who venture beyond the safety of secure space in search of glory and riches. Low and null security space can be very dangerous but the rewards often match the risks, especially if you fly with other pilots. There are thousands of capsuleer corporations waiting out there to bring you into their fleets and help you get those guns firing on target. 584144 Subjected to an Amarr campaign of annihilation, the Starkmanir Tribe was considered lost for centuries until the discovery in YC110 of a viable surviving population hidden by Nefantar elites on Halturzhan, the sixth planet of Jarizza in the Ammatar Mandate. The discovery spurred a Minmatar fleet into an invasion of Amarr territories with a view to recovering the Starkmanir and as many other enslaved Minmatar as possible. The vast majority of surviving Starkmanir were successfully recovered, evacuated to the Minmatar Republic, and settled on lands set aside for them by the larger tribes.

Though few in number, the Starkmanir have full status as one of the Seven Tribes of Matar and govern their affairs through a council of clan chiefs headed by the overall chief of the Starkmanir Tribe. In YC128, 13,957 capsuleers contirbuted ot the Starkmanir Restoration campaign. Thanks to this campaign, the Starkmanir homeworld of Starkman Prime was reclaimed by the Republic. Now every day more and more of the Starkmanir and their allies return to Starkman Prime to work on returning the planet to its former glory. 584164 The Nefantar Tribe played a notorious role during the Amarr Empire's occupation of the Minmatar home worlds as collaborators who actively assisted in the enslavement of other tribes by the Amarr. The Nefantar were so faithful to the Amarr that Emperor Damius III bestowed the name "Ammatar" upon them. When the Great Rebellion succeeded in driving the Amarr from the Minmatar Regions, the Amarr subsequently set up the Nefantar in a puppet state called the Ammatar Mandate. Unbeknownst to anyone else, certain Ammatar elites had hidden a large number of Starkmanir Tribe survivors from the Amarr within the Mandate.

After the discovery of the Starkmanir led to a Minmatar invasion in YC110, the Nefantar conspirators and their families led a mass defection of many Ammatar back to the Minmatar Republic, assisting in the recovery of the Starkmanir. Today, the Nefantar tribe has been restored as one of the Seven Tribes of Matar, even while many of their tribe remain loyal to the Amarr Empire back in the Mandate. Unbeknownst to anyone else, certain Ammatar elites had hidden a largeRepublic, and settled on lands set aside for them by the larger tribes.

Though few in number of, the Starkmanir Tribe survivors from the Amarr within the Mandate.

After the discovery of the Starkmanir led to a Minmatar invasion in YC110, the Nefantar conspirators and their families led a mass defection of many Ammatar back to the Minmatar Republic, assisting in the recovery of the Starkmanir. Today, the Nefantar tribe has been resthave full status as one of the Seven Tribes of Matar and govern their affairs through a council of clan chiefs headed by the overall chief of the Starkmanir Tribe.

In YC128, 13,957 capsuleers contirbuted ot the Starkmanir Restoration campaign. Thanks to this campaign, the Starkmanir homeworld of Starkman Prime was reclaimed by the Republic. Now every day mored as onnd more of the Seven Tribes of Matar, even while many of their tribe remain loyal to the Amarr Empire back tarkmanir and their allies return to Starkman Prime to work on returning the Mandateplanet to its former glory. 585506 Amarr Soldiers of Fortune focused on militia warfare start their career flying tech 1 Amarr combat frigates, such as the Punisher: Amarr Soldier of Fortune. Amarr Militia Fighters battle other capsuleers for control over space and resources, in the name of the Amarr Empire.

Militia Fighters train skills focusing on combat and survivability, as well as diplomatic skills that increase rewards and standings from corporations, and the use of boosters to give themselves an edge in combat.

To learn more about the Militia Fighter career, head to the Faction Warfare panel in the Agency. 599598 <font size="14">AIR Soldier of Fortune</font>

This Expert System is sponsored by the Association for Interdisciplinary Research (AIR) to allow new capsuleers to try out a variety of ships and activities before having to train the required skills.

It makes skills available that enable a capsuleer to fly all frigates from all four Empires, while its supporting skills make it especially useful when fighting against other capsuleers or providing support for your fleet. This Expert System includes skills related to armor, shields, missiles, drones, projectile turrets, hybrid turrets, energy turrets, electronic warfare modules, and remote assistance modules.

An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump.

Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.		 <font size="14">AIR Soldier</font>

600462 Special Affairs for Regulations & Order (SARO) is an secretive elite branch of CONCORD's Directive Enforcement Department. 1009281 <font size="14">Soldier of Fortune Expert System</font>

This Expert System makes available skills enabling a capsuleer to fly various T1 Cruisers.

The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for 7 days.

An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump.

<font size="14">Activating an Expert System</font>

Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service.

Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.		 <font size="14">Soldier Expert System</font>

1039457 Prototype 'Pluto' Mining Drone 'Pluto' Mining Drone Prototype 'Pluto' Mining Drone Name of item 93143 (Mining Drone)
1039458 A prototype drone developed by CreoDron based on ORE's 'Excavator' mining drone design by incorporating experimental rogue drone technology. The harvesting protocols have been altered to behave much more like a Rogue Drone would when salvaging and recycling materials to be brought back to a rogue drone hive. The result is a far more efficient mining process creating less residue, albeit a slower one resulting in lower mining yields over time.

Currently this drone is unsuitable for mass production due to a high rejection rate with the rogue drone technology. CreoDron is hoping to improve their understanding of this process from knowledge gained from the Gallente Federation Military Campaign operation 'Rogue Edge'.		 Developed by CreoDron, this drone has integrated Rogue Drone advancements. These integrations have resulted in an intelligent meticulousness, greatly reducing residue waste at the cost of slower mining cycles.

The Rogue Drone integration is the result of the Gallente Federation’s successful Rogue Edge research campaign. 17,129 capsuleers contributed towards the campaign during its duration. 1048030 With the specter of Conquest technology on the horizon in YC128, the Republic Fleet issued a request for a new Balttlecruiser that might help provide some edge to the strike teams expected to be a part of that conflict. Though Conquest technology had been restricted by agreement with CONCORD, many felt that its deployment was inevitable, and the Minmatar wished to be proactive in their fear.

The result was the Tornado Fleet issue, an advanced Republic Fleet vessel. Despite its proud suite of improvements over the original model, detractors claimed that this vessel was merely a conventional weapon that could in no way match the awesome power of the Conquest Engines. It was conceived as a vessel primed and ready for any capsuleer, no matter how new to the dangers of New Eden they might be, who wishes to engage in the respectable trade of mining.

1050604 Raspite Z-Grade Raspite Z-Grade Name of item 96286 (Raspite)
1050605 This rich variant of Raspite ore is especially prized by Amarr engineers for use in large-scale construction projects. Unfortunately, most known deposits of Raspite Z-Grade are found in the contested space of the Amarr and Minmatar warzone.

Unlike regular Raspite ore, Z-Grade is more stable and can be reprocessed without specialized equipment into Mexallon and Nocxium.

Reprocessing will also produce Aberrant Raspite. The Amarr Empire will reward anyone who accepts their campaign objective and delivers this Aberrant material to their item trader outside the Amarr Navy Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30002974>Mehatoor</url>.		 This rich variant of Raspite ore is especially prized by Amarr engineers for use in large-scale construction projects. Unfortunately, most known deposits of Raspite Z-Grade are found in the contested space of the Amarr and Minmatar warzone.

Unlike regular Raspite ore, Z-Grade is more stable and can be reprocessed without specialized equipment into <a href=showinfo:36>Mexallon</a> and <a href=showinfo:38>Nocxium</a>.

1051280 Small Dark Blood Synchronizer Small Dark Blood Synchronizer Name of item 96541 (Rig Synchronizer)
1051281 Built by Blood Raider engineers from combined Amarr and Minmatar synchronizers, this rig improves Energy Nosferatu, Energy Neutralizer and Energy Turret performance. However, the brute force combination that powers this synchronizer takes a significant toll on its capacitor recharge. It also integrates the pathways between Dark Blood technology. This unlocks even greater performance the more Dark Blood modules are installed.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.

The CPU drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Synchronization Rigging skill. 1051952 Medium Dread Guristas Synchronizer Medium Dread Guristas Synchronizer Name of item 96719 (Rig Synchronizer)
1051953 Built from Caldari synchronizers hacked to accommodate Gallente software, this rig improves drones, ECM modules, and shield resistances. However, the incompatibility of the Gallente firmware with Caldari technology results in greatly reduced drone control ranges. It also integrates the pathways between Dread Guristas technology. This unlocks even greater performance the more Dread Guristas modules are installed.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.

The CPU drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Synchronization Rigging skill. 1053388 The Kestrel is a heavy missile boat with one of the most sophisticated sensor arrays around. Interestingly enough, it has been used by both the Caldari Navy and several wealthy trade corporations as a cargo-hauling vessel. It is one of few trading vessels with good punching power, making it ideal for solo trade-runs in dangerous areas. The Kestrel was designed so that it could take up to four missile launchers but as a result it can not be equipped with turret weapons nor with mining lasers.

This is a special AIR Academy version of the Kestrel. It is provided free of charge to capsuleers within Exordium to assist with their training. It cannot be flown out of Exordium, traded, or reprocessed.		 The Kestrel is a heavy missile boat with one of the most sophisticated sensor arrays around. 1054893 This variant of Polycrase ore is especially prized by Caldari engineers for use in large-scale construction projects. Deposits have been held in reserve until such a time as the State needed them.

Unlike regular Polycrase ore, X-Grade is more stable and can be reprocessed without specialized equipment into Tritanium and Pyerite.

Reprocessing will also produce Aberrant Polycrase. The Caldari State will reward anyone who accepts their campaign objective and delivers this Aberrant material to their item trader outside the Caldari Navy Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30045324>Onnamon</url>. 1055948 Basic Conquest Glamourex Booster Basic Conquest Glamourex Booster Name of item 97747 (Booster)
1055949 Impetus developed the Glamourex neural booster as a means to improve the charm and appeal of its holoreel stars. Generally used at a low dosage on valuable hot properties such as actors and other celebrities, Impetus does make Glamourex available at higher, possibly inadvisable potencies for those who require a rapid boost in their social standing. Working much like the Social skill this booster provides a 20% bonus to agent, corporation and faction standing increases.

Volatile compounds were used to create this booster, limiting its shelf life. It will cease to function after February 2nd, 2027		 Impetus developed the Glamourex neural booster as a means to improve the charm and appeal of its holoreel stars. 1056851 Imperial Navy Stasis Webifier Imperial Navy Stasis Webifier Name of item 97955 (Stasis Web)
1056852 Reduces the maximum speed of a ship by employing micro energy streams that effectively entangle the target temporarily, thereby slowing it down.

In YC128, 14,161 capsuleers contributed to the Blessed Exchange campaign. It is thanks to that campaign’s economic reforms that the Imperial Navy was able to finance the development of its own Stasis Webifier version.		 Reduces the maximum speed of a ship by employing micro energy streams that effectively entangle the target temporarily, thereby slowing it down.

In YC128, 14,161 capsuleers contributed to the Blessed Exchange campaign. It is thanks to that campaign’s economic reforms that the Imperial Navy was able to finance the development of its own Stasis Webifier version.		 Description of item "Imperial Navy Stasis Webifier" (97955)
1056853 Each objective completed will unlock temporary system-wide effects across the Amarr Empire that remain in place until the Conquest embargo fails:
Deliver Hyperspherical Housings: +7.5% Bonus to Maximum Capacitor Amount
Deliver Republic Strategic Intel: +10% Bonus to Energy Neutralizer and Energy Vampire drain amount
Deliver Aberrant Raspite: +50% to Mining Critical Hit Chance
Deliver Thermoelectric Flux Logs: +2 AU/s bonus to warp speed

On campaign completion, Imperial Navy modules which could be traded for with the Into the Light Trader will be added to the 24th Imperial Crusade LP store.

If the Into the Light campaign is completed before the Minmatar’s Trail of Silence campaign, then Captain Marshal Sirdan Xer Qosh will personally attend the battle for the Emergent Artifact, providing command bonuses to all Amarr enlisted pilots. 1057720 Hall of Restoration Hall of Restoration Name for station operation 128
1057723 The planet this station orbits was once a lush tropical world. It was first settled by the Starkmanir Tribe in the days of the old Minmatar Empire. During the Amarr occupation, the Starkmanir rebelled, and in retribution the Amarr laid waste to their planet and attempted to wipe them out.

For centuries, it was thought that they had succeeded. It was not until YC110 that the Starkmanir survivors were revealed and restored to the Republic. In YC128, those survivors began returning thanks to a campaign of restoration supported by 13,957 capsuleers. This station serves as the center of their repopulation efforts, and from its elevated position the Starkmanir and their allies can look out at what remains of the world they can once again call home.		 The planet this station orbits was once a lush tropical world. It was first settled by the Starkmanir Tribe in the days of the old Minmatar Empire. This station serves as the center of their repopulation efforts, and from its elevated position the Starkmanir and their allies can look out at what remains of the world they can once again call home. Toggle the preview version on or off at any time, no restart required.

1060088 Once active and uncontested, this engine will secure control of this entire star system on the behalf of the Caldari State.

The engine makes use of “Conquest technology”, brute force manipulations of hyperspace backward engineered from Drifter technology. A powerful burst of energy is transferred through hyperspace, bypassing three-dimensional defenses and overpowering the command systems in every military complex, defense grid, war facility, and planetary defense system within the local star's gravity well. This grants its masters, the Caldari State, uncontested control over the star system for as long as the engine remains active.

The only known force capable of stopping the engine from firing is another Conquest engine, and it must be the sole operational device of its type within range in order to fire.		 Once active and uncontested, this engine will secure control of this entire star system on the behalf of the Caldari State.

The engine makes use of “Conquest technology”, brute force manipulations of hyperspace backward engineered from Drifter technology. A powerful burst of energy is transferred through hyperspace, bypassing three-dimensional defenses and overpowering the command systems in every military complex, defense grid, war facility, and planetary defense system within the local star's gravity well. This grants its masters, the Caldari State, uncontested control over the star system for as long as the engine remains active.

The only known force capable of stopping the engine from firing is another Conquest engine, and it must be the sole operational device of its type within range in order to fire.		 Description of item "State Conquest Engine" (96312)
1060089 Once active and uncontested, this engine will secure control of this entire star system on the behalf of the Gallente Federation.

The Federation engine is not a true example of Conquest technology. This engine makes use of Rogue Infestation technology to create a facsimile of the hyperspace energy bursts used in true Conquest tech. The AI infestation is overclocked, accelerating its effects to peak performance before being unleashed in order ot overpower the command systems in every military complex, defense grid, war facility, and planetary defense system within the system. This grants the Federation uncontested control over the star system territory for as long as the engine remains active.

The only known force capable of stopping a Conquest engine from firing is another Conquest engine, and the overclocked infestation achieves this by waging a non-stop barrage of cyber attacks on any Conquest engine within range, preventing them from firing as long as it is in operation, but also preventing itself from firing through this process.

Because of this, it must be the sole operational Conquest engine within range in order to activate.		 Once active and uncontested, this engine will secure control of this entire star system on the behalf of the Gallente Federation.

The only known force capable of stopping a Conquest engine from firing is another Conquest engine, and the overclocked infestation achieves this by waging a non-stop barrage of cyber attacks on any Conquest engine within range, preventing them from firing as long as it is in operation, but also preventing itself from firing through this process.

Because of this, it must be the sole operational Conquest engine within range in order to activate.		 Description of item "Federation Conquest Engine" (96313)
